shared_elements: incised linear bands or patterned areas
low-relief carving on a large block
justification: Both are large stone works bearing a humanoid form with a prominent circular disc set against the chest/arm area and incised linear banding, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a heavily eroded, frontally conceived three-dimensional monolith with crude, shallow motifs, while B is a crisp, finely detailed profile relief panel with elaborate wing feathering and coiffure rendered by a highly practised hand.
